about: Reviewed exceptions to palette coverage (scripts/cmux-next/palette-coverage.py; cmuxterm-hq goals/palette-all-actions.md): a CLI or menu action, or a hand-built menu, the command palette needs no row for. Each entry is {surface, name, reason}, the reason one line starting "keep: " that says why. cli_verbs lists cmux-tui's own grammar verbs (`--refresh-cli` reads them from the binary named in cli_source): {verb, palette} names the palette-offered action that does the same, {verb, reason} a "keep: " reason, a bare {verb} is a gap. inventoried names the lists compared.

keep.name: terminalPaste
keep.reason: keep: every row runs a palette-offered action: terminalCopy, terminalPaste, terminal.selectAll

keep.name: homeBackground
keep.reason: keep: every row runs a palette-offered action: home.newMessage, home.newChief, home.createChannel, home.invite, home.inviteToTeam, home.showHiddenConversations, openTeamPicker

keep.name: browserReload
keep.reason: keep: every row runs a palette-offered action: browserReload, browserHardReload

keep.name: browserMachineBadge
keep.reason: keep: its one row is browser.openOnMachine, palette-offered

keep.name: browserProfileLink
keep.reason: keep: a row per browser profile; the palette's browserProfile.openLink picks the same profile

keep.name: bookmarkFolder
keep.reason: keep: a row per bookmark; the palette's bookmark.open lists the same bookmarks, and bookmark.openAll opens a folder

keep.name: browserMedia
keep.reason: keep: a card per media tab; the palette's browser.media.show lists them and tab.focus shows one

keep.name: browserDevice
keep.reason: keep: device choices; the palette's browserDevice (Emulate Device) offers the same list

keep.name: titlebarHistory
keep.reason: keep: location rows; the palette's recentlyFocused (Location History), history.reopen and history.show cover them

keep.name: debugSidebarToggleIcon
keep.reason: keep: Debug-only icon choices; the same tunable is a Debug setting row in the palette (DebugSettingsService)

keep.name: import.list
keep.reason: keep: an agent's read of the import cards it may suggest (`cmux import list`); a person imports with the palette's Import from Browser (importFromBrowser)

keep.name: import.card
keep.reason: keep: an agent presses an import card's button by id (`cmux import card`); a person presses the card itself, and the palette's Import from Browser does the import

keep.name: import.suggest
keep.reason: keep: an agent asks to show a site's cookie import card (`cmux import suggest`); a person imports with the palette's Import from Browser (importFromBrowser)

cli_verbs.reason: keep: a listing; the palette's Accounts… (accounts.show) shows the same accounts
